The safety and effectiveness of IBSRELA in patients less than 18 years of age have not been established. Juvenile Animal Toxicity Data In a 21-day oral dose range finding toxicity study in juvenile rats, tenapanor was administered to neonatal rats (post-natal day (PND) 5) at doses of 5 and 10 mg/kg/day.
